species.name: American Robin
species.description: The American Robin is a migratory songbird of the true thrush genus and Turdidae, the wider thrush family. It is named after the European robin because of its reddish-orange breast, though the two species are not closely related.
characteristics: Dark gray to black head and back
species.habitat: Woodlands, parks, gardens, and lawns across North America
species.behavior: Known for pulling earthworms from lawns, territorial during breeding season, forms flocks in winter

species.name: Blue Jay
species.description: The Blue Jay is a passerine bird in the family Corvidae, native to eastern North America. It is a highly intelligent and social bird known for its distinctive blue coloration and complex vocalizations.
characteristics: Bright blue upper parts with white underparts
Prominent blue crest that can be raised or lowered
White and black barred wings and tail
species.habitat: Deciduous and mixed forests, parks, and residential areas with large trees
species.behavior: Highly social, forms complex family groups, known for mobbing predators, excellent mimics
species.diet: Nuts, seeds, insects, eggs, and small animals

species.name: Northern Cardinal
species.description: The Northern Cardinal is a bird in the genus Cardinalis. It is also known colloquially as the redbird, common cardinal, red cardinal, or just cardinal. Males are vibrant red while females are a warm brown with red accents.
characteristics: Males: Brilliant red all over with black mask
Females: Warm brown with red tinges on wings, tail, and crest
Black face mask around beak and eyes (males)
species.habitat: Woodlands, gardens, shrublands, and wetlands with dense cover
species.behavior: Non-migratory, territorial, males sing to defend territory, females also sing
